title: Solutions or Replacement for Bukit Panjang LRT System
what_it_is: Solutions or Replacement for Bukit Panjang LRT System

sections.label: Causes of major disruptions
sections.summary: Sixty percent of major disruptions in the past three years were caused by power trips or dislodged collector shoes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Sixty percent of the major disruptions in the past three years were caused by power trips or dislodged collector shoes.

sections.label: BPLRT components reaching design lives
sections.summary: Many key components, including trains, power rail and signalling system, reach the end of their design lives in about four to five years, and the BPLRT is being redone.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Meanwhile, many key components, including the trains, power rail and the signalling system, are coming to the end of their design lives in about four to five years' time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: We are taking this opportunity to redo the BPLRT to enable a step jump in reliability.

sections.label: Sourcing replacement assets for BPLRT
sections.summary: New trains, power rail, signalling system and other critical components are being sourced to replace first-generation assets, and there have been suggestions to replace the BPLRT with a bus-only system.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Second, we are sourcing for new trains, power rail, signalling system and various other critical components to replace our first-generation assets.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: There have been suggestions to replace the BPLRT with a bus-only transport system.

sections.label: BPLRT investments and losses
sections.summary: The member asks whether investments in the older Bukit Panjang LRT have been recovered, and notes SMRT's understanding that the BPLRT has always been loss-making.

sentences.speaker: Mr Azmoon Ahmad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The investments made on the older LRT in Bukit Panjang, have they been recovered already?

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: I think from a purely financial viewpoint, my understanding from SMRT is it has always been loss-making for the BPLRT.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: But they are also responsible for the North-South East-West Lines.

sections.label: Investing resources in train operators
sections.summary: A good train service requires sufficient resources invested in the operator, and since resources come from Government and fares, fare revisions must be timely and adequate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: From an overall system's point of view, I must make a point that if you want a good train service, one must invest sufficient resources into the operator, whoever is the operator.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Since resources come from both the Government as well as fares collection, fare revisions have to be timely and adequate.
